title: The Wrong Hostel Locker
story: Rafael opened the hostel locker and found a camera that was not his. The tag showed a room number on the floor above, so he took the camera to reception instead of leaving a note. The clerk matched it to a guest who had used the wrong key the night before. Rafael collected his own bag and still caught the afternoon bus.
